replication.target_description: Relationship between object type (food versus other objects) and movement initiation or reaching times in the push condition. Initiation and reaching are distinct outcomes; food and comparison categories are not uniquely specified. A push-condition label alone cannot distinguish these tests.

n.sample_role: Candidate abstract count: 27 participants; target-test analytic inclusion unresolved.
n.exclusions: Excerpt reports 14.2 % erroneous trials, 3.3 % early movements and 2.5 SD outlier correction (1.83 % onset, 2.53 % contact, 2.57 % collection); one additional session cancelled. No N derived from these percentages or df.
